next_step_summary: PR #253 implements the third accepted post-audit correction by adding a minimal repeatable-mechanism schema: MechanismCollection owns collection-local unique mechanism IDs, each MechanismInstance keeps its mechanism type and properties together, and each MechanismProperty carries its own AnswerState. Security is the stress-test family, so multiple security instruments can no longer be modeled only as unrelated parallel arrays that allow amount, blank, payee, trigger, or return properties to drift between instruments. The schema remains provider-independent and intentionally leaves typed values, evidence references, provider runtime, statutory runtime, and mass migration of all inventories for later bounded work. The next corrective slice structures CONFIRMED / NARROWED / CLEARED finding resolution so a candidate concern can be narrowed or removed after cross-clause review.
